$comment: TrackIt pilot dashboard (PostHog EU). Create each insight as SQL (HogQL) in PostHog after sign-up; names and KPI IDs follow docs/measurement/KPI-PLAN.md. Layer-1 KPIs (KPI-O-01, KPI-L-01, KPI-L-03) are SQL on the app database in analytics/kpi/, not PostHog.

query.query: SELECT event, count() AS events, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'trackit' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC

insights.name: KPI-L-02 Updates per active user per week
insights.min_volume: 20 active users per week, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, uniqIf(distinct_id, event IN ('tracking_item_added', 'tracking_updated', 'tracking_item_removed')) AS active_users, countIf(event = 'tracking_updated') AS updates, if(active_users >= 20, round(updates / active_users, 2), NULL) AS updates_per_active_user FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'trackit' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-L-04 Find usage rate (consented visitors)
insights.min_volume: 20 consented visitors per week, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) AS week, uniqIf(person_id, event = '$pageview') AS visitors, uniqIf(person_id, event = 'collection_filtered') AS finders, if(visitors >= 20, round(100 * finders / visitors, 1), NULL) AS find_usage_pct FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'trackit' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-G-01 Tracking write server-error rate
insights.min_volume: 100 writes per day, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS day, countIf(event IN ('tracking_item_added', 'tracking_updated', 'tracking_item_removed', 'tracking_write_failed')) AS writes, countIf(event = 'tracking_write_failed' AND toInt(properties.status_code) >= 500) AS server_errors, if(writes >= 100, round(100 * server_errors / writes, 2), NULL) AS server_error_rate_pct FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'trackit' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
